This part-time role involves monitoring and maintaining network infrastructure, resolving hardware and software issues, and ensuring secure, reliable connectivity across departments. The specialist will install and configure workstations and peripherals, manage user accounts and access permissions, and support staff with applications used in clinical
eligibility_evidence: Role Description The Information Technology Specialist will provide on-site support for all hospital IT systems at Elsallab New Heliopolis Hospital in Cairo.
Experience in healthcare or hospital environments, familiarity with electronic medical systems, and the ability to work on-site in Cairo are advantageous.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Information Technology knowledge and hands-on experience with common operating systems and hospital-related applications. Relevant qualifications such as a diploma or degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field are beneficial.
